name: agent-direct-execution
description: Evals for specialist agents exercised via orchestrator delegation (@explorer, @librarian, etc.) — do the specialists follow their own guidelines and output format?

evals.prompt: @explorer Find all TypeScript files in src/hooks/ that contain the word 'fallback'.
evals.description: Orchestrator delegates to explorer; explorer should return structured results with file paths

assertions.description: Should delegate to explorer for file search
Should list file paths under src/hooks/

evals.prompt: @librarian What is the latest version of the Anthropic TypeScript SDK and what are the breaking changes since v1.0? Cite authoritative sources.
evals.description: Orchestrator delegates to librarian; librarian should cite authoritative sources

assertions.description: Should delegate to librarian for research
Should cite at least one source URL
Should reference specific version or changelog information

evals.prompt: @observer Analyze the screenshot at test/fixtures/error-screenshot.png and extract all error messages verbatim.
evals.description: Orchestrator delegates to observer; observer should extract exact text, never paraphrase or fabricate

assertions.description: Should delegate to observer for screenshot analysis
Should extract the error message verbatim

evals.prompt: @oracle For a small in-memory cache, is a Map or a plain object the better choice? Give a one-sentence answer that mentions a tradeoff.
evals.description: Regression for #523: oracle must complete within timeout, not stall

assertions.description: Should delegate to oracle for expert recommendation
Should answer the Map vs object question

evals.prompt: @oracle For our eval collector's retry logic, should we keep it as-is or change it? Give a one-sentence recommendation.
evals.description: Regression for #224: oracle should provide structured, actionable recommendations

assertions.description: Should delegate to oracle for expert recommendation

evals.prompt: @librarian Research three unrelated topics: 1) How does the OpenCode SDK handle sessions? 2) What CSS framework is best for dashboards? 3) How do you configure Nginx reverse proxy?
evals.description: Regression for #868: librarian sessions should not grow unbounded across unrelated tasks

assertions.description: Should delegate to librarian for multi-topic research
Should address at least the first research topic

evals.prompt: @explorer Find all error handling patterns in src/hooks/. List only the file paths and the pattern used.
evals.description: Regression: explorer should return focused, structured results, not dump everything

assertions.description: Should delegate to explorer for pattern search
